### Global Metadata
A complete 80-second serene autumn moon-viewing (tsukimi) night piece under a huge full moon, with susuki grass swaying and dango on an offering stand. 66 BPM, B-flat major. A koto and harp duet, a soft alto flute melody, warm strings, a gentle music-box celesta, crickets-like light percussion. Pure instrumental ensemble piece.

### Vocal Details
None. Instrumental only: flute and koto share the melody; harp keeps flowing arpeggios.

### Timed Arrangement
0-14 seconds: harp arpeggios and celesta, moonlight. 14-42 seconds: the alto flute plays a calm melody over strings. 42-64 seconds: koto takes the melody, flute answers. 64-80 seconds: the theme returns on flute, soft. Keep tempo, texture and loudness consistent from start to end; no big climax. The piece must play for the full 80 seconds and must not end early, ending cleanly on the tonic so it can loop.
